rationale: BEZ gapped up ~6.4% and has already experienced a sharp intraday fade (high $6.55 → low $6.07 on the largest volume candle at 280K shares), with price now stabilizing near the 5-min VWAP at $6.22, sitting at only 33.8% of today's range. The short thesis (gap fade continuation) is undermined by the bounce already underway from $6.07 and proximity to today's low leaving minimal reward versus risk; the long thesis (bounce continuation) is undermined by the bearish rejection from the open and no news catalyst to anchor a move. With a 96-bps spread, missing ATR/EMA data, no news context, and the gap having already partially filled, the edge is insufficient to justify a position in either direction.
